name: Gate 5B-5 Excel-like Filter Search Selection Fix
scope: ERP filter popup only; RevoGrid source is not modified
behavior: Typing a non-empty Search term automatically replaces the pending checkbox selection with the matching popup options.
The grid is not filtered while typing; RevoGrid Community applies the filter only when Apply is pressed.
Select All while Search is active affects only currently searched/visible options.
Clearing Search text preserves the current pending checkbox selection.
Apply is disabled when the pending selection is empty so a no-match Search cannot accidentally show the whole sheet.
Date Search uses the same selection rule and can match date text, year, month number/name, or day.

architecture.community: RevoGrid Community 4.25.2 remains the native filtering engine through FilterPlugin/multiFilterItems.
architecture.pro_reference: RevoGrid Pro selection filter documents select-all-visible and supports disabling live quick-search row filtering with quickSearchFiltering=false.
architecture.excel_reference: Excel AutoFilter supports typing search criteria then applying the filter without first manually clearing Select All.

validation.dotnet_build: Not run in artifact container because dotnet is unavailable; user will build in Codespaces.

manual_test: Open Work Type filter, type 401, press Apply without changing Select All manually; only 401 rows should remain.
Undo once should restore the previous filter state; Redo should reapply it.
Search 40, uncheck 402, press Apply; only the still-checked matching values should remain.
Search a value that does not exist; Apply should be disabled.
Clear the Search text after searching 401; 401 should remain the pending checked selection until changed manually or Clear Filter is used.
